_: Off-season blurbs for the Teams view's form block (app.js renderTeamForm): shown before a season starts and once one is well over. Plain text, one per team slug. Edit freely — nothing generates this file.
eagles: The Eagles' WIAC season runs September to November at Veterans Memorial Stadium, five home Saturdays, with the Division III playoffs beyond that; the schedule arrives in the spring.
packers: The Packers' season runs September to January at Lambeau Field, with the playoffs beyond that; flex-week kickoffs fill in above as the league confirms them.
brewers: Spring training opens in Phoenix in February and the regular season in late March at American Family Field; the schedule above fills in once MLB publishes it.
bucks: The Bucks' season runs late October to April at Fiserv Forum, 41 home dates, with the play-in and the playoffs beyond that.
vikings: The Vikings' season runs September to January at U.S. Bank Stadium, with the playoffs beyond that; flex-week kickoffs fill in above as the league confirms them.
twins: Spring training opens in Fort Myers in February and the regular season in late March at Target Field; the schedule above fills in once MLB publishes it.
